review:
Reel of Ra is an Egyptian 243-ways slot with falcons, scarabs and pyramids. Its free spins work differently: the field clears to show coins only, and a dedicated multiplier reel beside the grid boosts every spin's total by 1x, 2x, 3x or 5x.

Filling every position during the bonus unlocks the 1,000x Grand Prize. BGaming rates it medium volatility with a 2,500x maximum and a 97.02% RTP. Free spins arrive about once every 120 spins. A good blend of a classic Egyptian look and a modern coin bonus.
pros: Excellent 97.02% RTP – among the highest published
Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 120 spins on average)
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
